reviewer: root Codex direct critical primary and fixed source inspection

AMD_DMA_Latte.read: IV-B, source-once/two-destination bcst, table and runtime batching; read in this turn
facts: Constructor accepts source plus two full independent destination addresses, sets broadcast flag, and writes each destination full64-bit field separately.

The read constructor has no check enforcing equal destination low12 bits; the benchmark call uses separate allocated GPU buffers. This establishes command construction, not hardware proof that every offset is supported.

Read packet structure has one source and destination array, but no per-destination permission frontier or Qi admission encoded in inspected fields. Queue/VMID context and unpublished GPU buffer/translation policy were not inspected.
AMD_DMA_Latte.judgment: Shared source multicast and independent destination addresses cannot be claimed as new; the inspected source does not settle permission/capacity admission or independent domain support.

Intel_DSA.direct_read: sections3.13 ATS/access/fault,4.3 Read Buffer Allocation,8.3.10 Dualcast and8.3.11 Translation Fetch
facts: Dualcast destination low12 bits must agree, and partial page-fault completion reports equal destination progress.
ATS and Translation Fetch already supply non-data translation preparation; finite reserved/allowed buffers already exist.
These external contracts do not expose internal C_i+Q_i policy. §3.14 contains inter-domain operations; no claim all DSA operations lack multiple address spaces.

Torrent.judgment: Per-output consumed flags already allow independent per-word acceptance; chain task/grant readiness is not a destination WRITE-permission certificate. Complete buffering/IOMMU extensions were not reviewed; no zero-buffer or missing-capability claim across entire system.

PTW_escape_prior.direct_read: shared response/PTW blockage cycle and independent IOMMU virtual-channel resources
PTW_escape_prior.judgment: Separate translation escape channels are established; do not rebrand that component as the proposed innovation.

scope: Exact reviewed components only; no field-wide novelty or hidden hardware policy inferred from absence.
